# Load packages

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratWrappers)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biobase)
library(BiocGenerics)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(harmony)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(monocle3)
library(NMF)
library(circlize)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(CellChat)
library(pheatmap)
```



# Load data

```{r, include=FALSE}
load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/scIntegration/muscle_integrated.RData")

rm(all_genes, DEGs_sc_combined, Agca_snLLC_CTL, Agca_snLLC_LLC, Brown_scLLC_CTL, Brown_scLLC_2w, Brown_scLLC_2.5w, Brown_scLLC_3.5w, Kim_scB16F10_CTL, Kim_scB16F10_B16F10, Pryce_scC26_CTL, Pryce_scC26_C26, Pryce_scKPP_CTL, Pryce_scKPP_KPP, Zhang_snKIC_CTL, Zhang_snKIC_KIC)


load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/Tumour_scRNAseq/LLC_tumours_scRNAseq.RData")
LLC_tumour <- LLC_tumour_singlets
rm(LLC_tumour_singlets)

load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/Tumour_scRNAseq/B16_tumours_scRNAseq.RData")
B16_tumour <- B16_tumour_so_norm
rm(B16_tumour_so_norm)

load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/Tumour_scRNAseq/MC38_tumours_immune_scRNAseq.RData")
MC38_tumour <- MC38_tumour_singlets
rm(MC38_tumour_singlets)

load("C:/Users/nwb_l/Documents/r_projects/Tumour_scRNAseq/KPC_tumours_scRNAseq.RData")
KPC_tumour <- KPC_combined
rm(KPC_combined)

rm(all_genes_B16_tumour, all_genes_KPC_tumours, all_genes_LLC_tumour)
```



# Specify "Muscle" or "Tumour" in seurat objects

```{r, include=FALSE}
sc_combined$seurat_clusters <- paste("Muscle", sc_combined$seurat_clusters)
Idents(sc_combined) <- sc_combined$seurat_clusters

LLC_tumour$seurat_clusters <- paste("Tumour", LLC_tumour$seurat_clusters)
Idents(LLC_tumour) <- LLC_tumour$seurat_clusters

B16_tumour$seurat_clusters <- paste("Tumour", B16_tumour$seurat_clusters)
Idents(B16_tumour) <- B16_tumour$seurat_clusters

MC38_tumour$seurat_clusters <- paste("Tumour", MC38_tumour$seurat_clusters)
Idents(MC38_tumour) <- MC38_tumour$seurat_clusters

KPC_tumour$seurat_clusters <- paste("Tumour", KPC_tumour$seurat_clusters)
Idents(KPC_tumour) <- KPC_tumour$seurat_clusters
```



# Subset for conditions

```{r, include=FALSE}
Idents(sc_combined) <- "orig.ident"

LLC_ctl_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Agca_snLLC_CTL", "Brown_scLLC_CTL"))
LLC_end_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Agca_snLLC_LLC", "Brown_scLLC_3.5w"))

B16_ctl_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Kim_scB16F10_CTL")
B16_end_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Kim_scB16F10_B16F10")

C26_ctl_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Pryce_scC26_CTL")
C26_end_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = "Pryce_scC26_C26")

KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Pryce_scKPP_CTL", "Zhang_snKIC_CTL"))
KPP_KIC_end_muscle <- subset(sc_combined, idents = c("Pryce_scKPP_KPP", "Zhang_snKIC_KIC"))

rm(sc_combined)
```



# Add in metadata about tissue type

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_ctl_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"
LLC_end_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"

B16_ctl_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"
B16_end_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"

C26_ctl_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"
C26_end_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"

KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"
KPP_KIC_end_muscle$tissue <- "Muscle"

LLC_tumour$tissue <- "Tumour"
B16_tumour$tissue <- "Tumour"
MC38_tumour$tissue <- "Tumour"
KPC_tumour$tissue <- "Tumour"
```


# Combine muscle and tumour objects

## Extract the counts layer you want from the muscle object
```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_ctl_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(LLC_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.SeuratProject", slot = "counts")
LLC_end_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(LLC_end_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.SeuratProject", slot = "counts")

B16_ctl_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(B16_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.SeuratProject", slot = "counts")
B16_end_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(B16_end_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.SeuratProject", slot = "counts")

C26_ctl_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(C26_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.1", slot = "counts")
C26_end_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(C26_end_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.1", slot = "counts")

KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.1", slot = "counts")
KPP_KIC_end_muscle_counts <- GetAssayData(KPP_KIC_end_muscle[["RNA"]], layer = "data.1", slot = "counts")



LLC_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = LLC_ctl_muscle_counts)
LLC_end_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = LLC_end_muscle_counts)

B16_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = B16_ctl_muscle_counts)
B16_end_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = B16_end_muscle_counts)

C26_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = C26_ctl_muscle_counts)
C26_end_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = C26_end_muscle_counts)

KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle_counts)
KPP_KIC_end_muscle[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = KPP_KIC_end_muscle_counts)

rm(LLC_ctl_muscle_counts, LLC_end_muscle_counts, B16_ctl_muscle_counts, B16_end_muscle_counts, C26_ctl_muscle_counts, C26_end_muscle_counts, KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle_counts, KPP_KIC_end_muscle_counts)
```


## Repeat for tumour

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_tumour_counts <- GetAssayData(LLC_tumour[["RNA"]], layer = "data", slot = "counts")
B16_tumour_counts <- GetAssayData(B16_tumour[["RNA"]], layer = "data", slot = "counts")
MC38_tumour_counts <- GetAssayData(MC38_tumour[["RNA"]], layer = "data", slot = "counts")
KPC_tumour_counts <- GetAssayData(KPC_tumour[["RNA"]], layer = "data", slot = "counts")



LLC_tumour[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = LLC_tumour_counts)
B16_tumour[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = B16_tumour_counts)
MC38_tumour[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = MC38_tumour_counts)
KPC_tumour[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = KPC_tumour_counts)

rm(LLC_tumour_counts, B16_tumour_counts, MC38_tumour_counts, KPC_tumour_counts)
```


## Merge muscle and tumour

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_ctl <- RenameCells(LLC_ctl_muscle, add.cell.id = "Muscle")

LLC_end <- merge(
  LLC_end_muscle,
  y = LLC_tumour,
  add.cell.ids = c("Muscle", "Tumour")
)

B16_ctl <- RenameCells(B16_ctl_muscle, add.cell.id = "Muscle")

B16_end <- merge(
  B16_end_muscle,
  y = B16_tumour,
  add.cell.ids = c("Muscle", "Tumour")
)

C26_ctl <- RenameCells(C26_ctl_muscle, add.cell.id = "Muscle")

C26_end <- merge(
  C26_end_muscle,
  y = MC38_tumour,
  add.cell.ids = c("Muscle", "Tumour")
)

KPP_KIC_ctl <- RenameCells(KPP_KIC_ctl_muscle, add.cell.id = "Muscle")

KPP_KIC_end <- merge(
  KPP_KIC_end_muscle,
  y = KPC_tumour,
  add.cell.ids = c("Muscle", "Tumour")
)
```


## Normalize

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_ctl <- NormalizeData(LLC_ctl)
LLC_end <- NormalizeData(LLC_end)

B16_ctl <- NormalizeData(B16_ctl)
B16_end <- NormalizeData(B16_end)

C26_ctl <- NormalizeData(C26_ctl)
C26_end <- NormalizeData(C26_end)

KPP_KIC_ctl <- NormalizeData(KPP_KIC_ctl)
KPP_KIC_end <- NormalizeData(KPP_KIC_end)
```


## Confirm layers

```{r}
Layers(LLC_ctl[["RNA"]])
Layers(LLC_end[["RNA"]])

Layers(B16_ctl[["RNA"]])
Layers(B16_end[["RNA"]])

Layers(C26_ctl[["RNA"]])
Layers(C26_end[["RNA"]])

Layers(KPP_KIC_ctl[["RNA"]])
Layers(KPP_KIC_end[["RNA"]])
```

# Create CellChat object

## GetAssayData

```{r, include=FALSE}
data_input_LLC_ctl <- GetAssayData(LLC_ctl[["RNA"]], layer = "data")
data_input_LLC_end <- GetAssayData(LLC_end[["RNA"]], layer = "data")

data_input_B16_ctl <- GetAssayData(B16_ctl[["RNA"]], layer = "data")
data_input_B16_end <- GetAssayData(B16_end[["RNA"]], layer = "data")

data_input_C26_ctl <- GetAssayData(C26_ctl[["RNA"]], layer = "data")
data_input_C26_end <- GetAssayData(C26_end[["RNA"]], layer = "data")

data_input_KPP_KIC_ctl <- GetAssayData(KPP_KIC_ctl[["RNA"]], layer = "data")
data_input_KPP_KIC_end <- GetAssayData(KPP_KIC_end[["RNA"]], layer = "data")
```


## Metadata

```{r, include=FALSE}
LLC_ctl_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_LLC_ctl)
LLC_end_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_LLC_end)

B16_ctl_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_B16_ctl)
B16_end_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_B16_end)

C26_ctl_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_C26_ctl)
C26_end_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_C26_end)

KPP_KIC_ctl_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_KPP_KIC_ctl)
KPP_KIC_end_common_cells <- colnames(data_input_KPP_KIC_end)



cellchat_LLC_ctl_meta <- LLC_ctl@meta.data[LLC_ctl_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]
cellchat_LLC_end_meta <- LLC_end@meta.data[LLC_end_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]

cellchat_B16_ctl_meta <- B16_ctl@meta.data[B16_ctl_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]
cellchat_B16_end_meta <- B16_end@meta.data[B16_end_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]

cellchat_C26_ctl_meta <- C26_ctl@meta.data[C26_ctl_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]
cellchat_C26_end_meta <- C26_end@meta.data[C26_end_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]

cellchat_KPP_KIC_ctl_meta <- KPP_KIC_ctl@meta.data[KPP_KIC_ctl_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]
cellchat_KPP_KIC_end_meta <- KPP_KIC_end@meta.data[KPP_KIC_end_common_cells, c("seurat_clusters", "orig.ident")]



colnames(cellchat_LLC_ctl_meta) <- c("group", "samples")
colnames(cellchat_LLC_end_meta) <- c("group", "samples")

colnames(cellchat_B16_ctl_meta) <- c("group", "samples")
colnames(cellchat_B16_end_meta) <- c("group", "samples")

colnames(cellchat_C26_ctl_meta) <- c("group", "samples")
colnames(cellchat_C26_end_meta) <- c("group", "samples")

colnames(cellchat_KPP_KIC_ctl_meta) <- c("group", "samples")
colnames(cellchat_KPP_KIC_end_meta) <- c("group", "samples")
```


## createCellChat

```{r, include=FALSE}
cellchat_LLC_ctl_all <- createCellChat(object = data_input_LLC_ctl, meta = cellchat_LLC_ctl_meta, group.by = "group")
```

# Rename "Tumour Endothelial cells/CAFS" to "Tumour ECs/CAFs"

```{r, include=FALSE}
rownames(cellchat_B16_end_secreted@net$count)[
  rownames(cellchat_B16_end_secreted@net$count) == "Tumour Endothelial cells/CAFs"
] <- "Tumour ECs/CAFs"

colnames(cellchat_B16_end_secreted@net$count)[
  colnames(cellchat_B16_end_secreted@net$count) == "Tumour Endothelial cells/CAFs"
] <- "Tumour ECs/CAFs"
```
